scope: Fresh three-seed development pilot of reward-only ablation; original cohort untouched; same150 public cases and80 evaluator calls; no held-out access.
provider_change: Original Wafer endpoint unavailable; same DeepInfra FP8 endpoint and explicit generation seed sequence for every arm. Historical saved scores are contextual only.

allocation_policy.reward: Control original binary1% versus noise-gated normalized gain; all other allocation policies fixed

comparison_limitations: Five seeds are exploratory, not conclusive evidence across two selected development tasks.
Native model and evaluation caps are competing stop rules; preserve early stops and report first80 eligible search calls.
Same algorithm seed and API seed convention do not guarantee identical histories or model responses.

noise_credit_ablation.single_change: Replace binary relative frontier-gain credit by scale-normalized positive frontier gain above a fixed empirical repeat-variation gate. Keep planner, writer parents, selection, trigger, probation, proposal order and CPU/case/evaluation budget fixed.
noise_credit_ablation.threshold_rule: Median across all20 frozen selected programs per task of absolute difference between the two public training rereads. Frozen before any new evolution. A heuristic sensitivity parameter, not a calibrated noise confidence bound.
noise_credit_ablation.gain_history: Prior finite positive global frontier gains from retained64-evaluation allocation history only. No future observations. Cold start credit1 above gate.
noise_credit_ablation.budget_constraint: Cumulative math cap74USD unchanged; about10USD conservatively available. No launch before integration tests and explicit paired protocol freeze.
noise_credit_ablation.caution: May suppress real gains or reward noisy ones; fractional Beta credits are heuristic. New runs remain development evidence and cannot establish statistical superiority from a small pilot.
